sources.title: ruMeme Descriptions
sources.author: foldl
sources.retrieval_method: Hugging Face datasets-server rows API; images stored locally without content modification
sources.notes: Russian-language meme images and dataset descriptions. Topic categories are derived locally from description keywords. Memes whose images contain English text are kept in a separate English memes filter. The top-text layout filters use a strict metadata rule plus OCR coordinates: any reliably recognized text below the upper 30 percent of the image excludes the meme. The remaining shortlist was visually reviewed.

sources.title: Ingenuity memes
sources.author: NASA Mars / JPL-Caltech
sources.license_evidence: Each linked Wikimedia Commons file identifies NASA Mars/JPL-Caltech as author and Public domain as its licence.
sources.retrieval_method: 500px JPEG copies downloaded from the individual Wikimedia Commons file pages; SHA-256 verified by scripts/import-nasa-ingenuity-memes.mjs
sources.selection_rule: Manually visually checked: one English text treatment in the upper part of the frame only; no text in the center or bottom.
